testCases.title: Display of Required Fields
expectedResults: All required fields are shown in the contact form.

testCases.title: Subject Dropdown Options
steps: Open the subject dropdown in the contact form.
expectedResults: The subject dropdown includes all specified options.

testCases.title: Message Length Validation
steps: Fill out the contact form with a message containing fewer than 50 characters.
expectedResults: A validation error is shown indicating the message must be at least 50 characters.

testCases.title: Confirmation Message on Successful Submission
steps: Fill out the contact form with valid information.
expectedResults: A confirmation message is displayed upon successful submission.
